<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>True joy comes from humility and self-nullification, where one recognizes their virtues as gifts from above, leading to complete joy.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter of joy that is in the aspect of self-nullification</t>
    <t s="2">(to the extent that even when the joy is in a state of revelation, it is nevertheless in the aspect of self-nullification),</t>
    <t s="3">behold, the true essence of joy comes from the side of humility and self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="4">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="5">"The humble will increase their joy in the L-rd."</t>
    <t s="6">And the explanation of the connection between humility and joy</t>
    <t s="7">(even though superficially they are two opposite matters),</t>
    <t s="8">is explained by the Alter Rebbe in the discourse "The humble will increase their joy in the L-rd"</t>
    <t s="9">[and in several discourses of our Rebbes and leaders after that,</t>
    <t s="10">and also in the aforementioned discourse of the Baal HaYom HaHuledes (the one whose birthday it is)],</t>
    <t s="11">that the matter of humility is not that the humble person is mistaken about himself and does not know his virtues,</t>
    <t s="12">but rather,</t>
    <t s="13">that even though he knows his virtues,</t>
    <t s="14">to the extent that he knows all his virtues</t>
    <t s="15">[for every Jew,</t>
    <t s="16">even those whose conduct is entirely improper,</t>
    <t s="17">not only do they have mitzvos, but the mitzvos fill their entire being,</t>
    <t s="18">and in the language of our Sages,</t>
    <t s="19">"they are full of mitzvos like a pomegranate,"</t>
    <t s="20">and especially since "Your people are all righteous"</t>
    <t s="21">and "all Jews are presumed to be kosher"],</t>
    <t s="22">nevertheless, he does not thereby become a [significant] entity in his own eyes, and certainly not in a state of yeshus (selfhood),</t>
    <t s="23">because he knows the truth that the virtues he has are not his own power and the strength of his hand, but rather were given to him</t>
    <t s="24">(the powers for this)</t>
    <t s="25">from Above,</t>
    <t s="26">and if these powers had been given to another, he too would be on this level,</t>
    <t s="27">and from the perspective of his humility and self-nullification, he thinks,</t>
    <t s="28">that if these powers were with another, he would reveal them even more.</t>
    <t s="29">And this humility</t>
    <t s="30">[since he knows his virtues,</t>
    <t s="31">but he does not thereby become a [significant] entity]</t>
    <t s="32">behold, not only does it not lead to the opposite of joy,</t>
    <t s="33">but on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="34">his humility and self-nullification</t>
    <t s="35">(that he thinks he does not deserve anything)</t>
    <t s="36">bring him to great and complete joy.</t>
    <t s="37">For the completeness of joy is specifically in one who is nullified,</t>
    <t s="38">as is explained at length in the discourse.</t>
    <t s="39">And since joy comes about because of humility and self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="40">therefore even the joy itself</t>
    <t s="41">(even when it is in revelation)</t>
    <t s="42">is in the aspect of self-nullification.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The life of Sarah encompasses the sefiros, and the phrase "the lives of Sarah" indicates a level above division where even the revealed is in nullification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is [the meaning of] "And the life of Sarah was... the years of the life of Sarah,"</t>
    <t s="2">"And the life of Sarah was" refers to that which she merited to attain supernal life.</t>
    <t s="3">And it specifies in this: one hundred years, twenty years, and seven years, which correspond to all the sefiros.</t>
    <t s="4">And as explained in the discourse,</t>
    <t s="5">that "one hundred years" is the aspect of Arich [Anpin], as the aspect of Atik shines within it,</t>
    <t s="6">therefore it is said</t>
    <t s="7">("one hundred")</t>
    <t s="8">years in the singular,</t>
    <t s="9">and it can be said that in our case it is above the aspect of "one."</t>
    <t s="10">And "twenty years" is the aspect of Chochmah and Binah,</t>
    <t s="11">and "seven years" is the aspect of the seven emotional attributes,</t>
    <t s="12">the seven days of construction.</t>
    <t s="13">And afterwards it adds "the years of the life of Sarah,"</t>
    <t s="14">"hers were the lives,"</t>
    <t s="15">that the lives were hers</t>
    <t s="16">(also)</t>
    <t s="17">in a felt [conscious] way,</t>
    <t s="18">that in [divine] service this is the matter of self-nullification within joy</t>
    <t s="19">(also)</t>
    <t s="20">as it is in revelation</t>
    <t s="21">(as above from the discourse of the Baal HaYom HaHuledes).</t>
    <t s="22">And this is also the reason that at the conclusion "the years of the life of Sarah" it does not specify the numbers one hundred, twenty, and seven,</t>
    <t s="23">because this [matter] that even the felt [revelation] is in self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="24">which is the unification of two opposite matters</t>
    <t s="25">(felt [revelation] and self-nullification),</t>
    <t s="26">is from an aspect that is above division.</t>
    <t s="27">And this is the superiority of "the years of the life of Sarah" over "the life of Sarah was one hundred years, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="28">for the matter of one hundred years, twenty years, and seven years,</t>
    <t s="29">although it is most elevated,</t>
    <t s="30">as is also understood from Rashi's commentary on the verse,</t>
    <t s="31">nevertheless, they are three distinct matters,</t>
    <t s="32">but not so "the years of the life of Sarah," for they are all equal,</t>
    <t s="33">above division.</t>
    <t s="34">And from this aspect</t>
    <t s="35">(which is above division),</t>
    <t s="36">even the felt [revelation] is in self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="37">"hers were the lives."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the service of making even revealed joy a state of nullification, one attains mastery over life itself, as joy breaks all boundaries.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that through the matter of "hers were the lives" in [divine] service,</t>
    <t s="2">that even the felt [revelation]</t>
    <t s="3">(joy that is in revelation)</t>
    <t s="4">is in self-nullification</t>
    <t s="5">(as per the interpretation of the Baal HaYom HaHuledes on "hers were the lives"),</t>
    <t s="6">through this, "hers were the lives" is also actualized in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="7">that the lives are hers and she becomes the master of the lives.</t>
    <t s="8">For joy breaks all boundaries,</t>
    <t s="9">and therefore, through joy in revelation</t>
    <t s="10">(and in the aspect of self-nullification)</t>
    <t s="11">there is a strengthening of life-force</t>
    <t s="12">(above measure and limitation),</t>
    <t s="13">and in the manner of the known concept</t>
    <t s="14">regarding Yitzchak</t>
    <t s="15">[whose concept is laughter and joy,</t>
    <t s="16">as above],</t>
    <t s="17">that the gevuros (severities) of Yitzchak are the matter of a strengthening of vitality</t>
    <t s="18">(and a strengthening of blessings),</t>
    <t s="19">to the extent of life in ultimate perfection,</t>
    <t s="20">analogous to "and we shall live before Him" which will be in the future to come.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
